name: Subscriptions
changes: First version: every renewal on one page, totals per month and year, a reminder before each one charges
description: Every subscription on one page: what it costs a month and a year, what renews next, and a reminder before it does.
schema: CREATE TABLE subs (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(8)))), name TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Other', emoji TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '💳', cents INTEGER NOT NULL, cycle TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'month', renews TEXT NOT NULL, remind_days INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3, created TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')))

INSERT INTO subs (id, name, kind, emoji, cents, cycle, renews, remind_days) VALUES ('cloud','Cloud storage','Work','☁️',299,'month',date('now','localtime','+1 day'),1),('video','Video streaming','Fun','🎬',1299,'month',date('now','localtime','+3 days'),3),('music','Music','Fun','🎧',1099,'month',date('now','localtime','+9 days'),3),('gym','Fitness studio','Health','🏋️',2990,'month',date('now','localtime','+14 days'),3),('learn','Language course','Learning','🗣️',999,'month',date('now','localtime','+19 days'),3),('news','Newspaper','Learning','📰',8900,'year',date('now','localtime','+41 days'),7),('notes','Notes and tasks','Work','📝',2499,'year',date('now','localtime','+118 days'),7)

card.query: SELECT n, CASE WHEN n = 0 THEN 'Add your first subscription' ELSE '**' || printf('%.2f', m / 100.0) || ' €** a month' END AS headline, printf('%.0f', m * 12 / 100.0) AS yr, coalesce((SELECT name FROM subs ORDER BY renews LIMIT 1), '–') AS nxt FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n, coalesce(sum(CASE cycle WHEN 'year' THEN cents / 12.0 ELSE cents END), 0) AS m FROM subs)
